applies_to: Trane CGAM air-cooled scroll chillers with the Symbio 800 controller, as listed in BAS-PTS019A-EN (11/15/2024).
summary: Trane's CGAM is an air-cooled scroll chiller with up to three compressors on each of two circuits. Its Symbio 800 controller serves BACnet and Modbus RTU/TCP from one points list. This map covers the analog inputs (setpoints, water and refrigerant temperatures and pressures, starts and run time, energy meter values), BAS setpoints, binary status points, multi-state modes and the diagnostic flags.

addressing.note: The list prints Modicon register numbers: 3xxxx are input registers and 4xxxx holding registers, so 30011 is input register address 10 and 42011 is holding register address 2010.

source.title: Symbio 800 Integration Points List, BACnet/Modbus, CGAM
source.pages: p. 28 (Modbus object format), pp. 29-51 (Modbus point tables)

notes: Register format table: analog points are 32-bit floats sent high word / high byte first (NaN = invalid); binary and multi-state points are unsigned 16-bit integers (0xFFFF = invalid).
Values are sent in the unit system ordered from the factory (I-P is the usual default, SI optional); the list names only the quantity, so temperature/pressure/flow units are left blank here.
Not every point exists on every unit: the controller builds its point set from the unit's configuration. Descriptions name the configuration a point depends on.
Register numbers are printed in 5-digit Modicon form (3xxxx input registers, 4xxxx holding registers) and converted here to wire addresses (30011 = input register 10).

Controller setup and the I-P/SI units statement come from Trane's Symbio 800 integration guide BAS-SVP047B-EN (Sept 2023, https://elibrary.tranetechnologies.com/public/commercial-hvac/Literature/Integration/BAS-SVP047B-EN_09092023.pdf), which describes the same Symbio 800 controller.

Evaporator and condenser saturated refrigerant temperature for circuit 2 (30051, 30053) are printed with the unit 'Percentage'; they are temperatures like their circuit 1 copies, so units are left blank.
Emergency Stop (33012) state 1 text runs into the next row in the PDF; it reads 'Emergency Stop - Manual Reset Required'.
Hot-water setpoints, defrost and condenser-approach points depend on the 'Hot Water Control' configuration.

integration.summary: Read the analog inputs as pairs of input registers (float, high word first) and the binary/multi-state points as single registers. Write the BAS setpoints and command points in the 4xxxx holding range.
integration.enable: On the Symbio 800 web interface go to Installation > Identification and Communications > Protocol Configuration and select Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP (per Trane's Symbio 800 integration guides).
quirks: Analog values are 32-bit floats occupying two registers; read both registers in one request.
0xFFFF in a binary or multi-state register and NaN in an analog register mean the value is invalid or not present.
setup: The Modbus RTU address comes from the controller's rotary dials (1-247); address 000 disables Modbus RTU.
Modbus TCP uses Ethernet port 2; the rotary address is ignored for TCP.
gotchas: Points not supported by the unit's configuration are absent; confirm the configuration dependencies before mapping.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
